versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E Moisés disse aos filhos de Israel, conforme tudo o que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.
controles.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.
controles.livre: E falou Moisés aos príncipes das tribos dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou.

versos.hebraico: אִישׁ֩ כִּֽי־יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽיהוָ֗ה אֽוֹ־הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶאְסֹ֤ר אִסָּר֙ עַל־נַפְשׁ֔וֹ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑וֹ כְּכָל־הַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
controles.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
controles.livre: Quando alguém fizer voto ao SENHOR, ou fizer juramento ligando sua alma com obrigação, não violará sua palavra: fará conforme tudo o que saiu de sua boca.

versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה כִּֽי־תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֖דֶר לַיהוָ֑ה וְאָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר בְּבֵ֥ית אָבִ֖יהָ בִּנְעֻרֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,
controles.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;
controles.livre: Mas a mulher, quando fizer voto ao SENHOR, e se ligar com obrigação em casa de seu pai, em sua juventude;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמַ֨ע אָבִ֜יהָ אֶת־נִדְרָ֗הּ וֶֽאֱסָרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וְהֶחֱרִ֥ישׁ לָ֖הּ אָבִ֑יהָ וְקָ֨מוּ֙ כָּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכָל־אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
controles.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
controles.livre: Se seu pai ouvir seu voto, e a obrigação com que ligou sua alma, e seu pai calar a isso, todos os votos dela serão firmes, e toda obrigação com que houver ligado sua alma, firme será.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־הֵנִ֨יא אָבִ֣יהָ אֹתָהּ֮ בְּי֣וֹם שָׁמְעוֹ֒ כָּל־נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם וַֽיהוָה֙ יִֽסְלַח־לָ֔הּ כִּי־הֵנִ֥יא אָבִ֖יהָ אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.
controles.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
controles.livre: Mas se seu pai lhe vedar no dia que ouvir todos os seus votos e suas obrigações, com que ela houver ligado sua alma, não serão firmes; e o SENHOR a perdoará, porquanto seu pai lhe vedou.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־הָי֤וֹ תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וּנְדָרֶ֖יהָ עָלֶ֑יהָ א֚וֹ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָֽׁהּ׃

controles.web: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,
controles.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
controles.livre: Porém se for casada, e fizer votos, ou pronunciar de seus lábios coisa com que obriga sua alma;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמַ֥ע אִישָׁ֛הּ בְּי֥וֹם שָׁמְע֖וֹ וְהֶחֱרִ֣ישׁ לָ֑הּ וְקָ֣מוּ נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛הָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֻֽמוּ׃

controles.web: and her husband hears it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
controles.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
controles.livre: Se seu marido o ouvir, e quando o ouvir calar a isso, os votos dela serão firmes, e a obrigação com que ligou sua alma, firme será.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠אִם בְּי֨וֹם שְׁמֹ֣עַ אִישָׁהּ֮ יָנִ֣יא אוֹתָהּ֒ וְהֵפֵ֗ר אֶת־נִדְרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֵת֙ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֑הּ וַיהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־לָֽהּ׃

controles.web: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.
controles.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.
controles.livre: Porém se quando seu marido o ouviu, lhe vedou, então o voto que ela fez, e o que pronunciou de seus lábios com que ligou sua alma, será nulo; e o SENHOR o perdoará.

versos.hebraico: וְנֵ֥דֶר אַלְמָנָ֖ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָק֥וּם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul, shall stand against her.
controles.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
controles.livre: Mas todo voto de viúva, ou repudiada, com que ligar sua alma, será firme.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־בֵּ֥ית אִישָׁ֖הּ נָדָ֑רָה אֽוֹ־אָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ בִּשְׁבֻעָֽה׃

controles.web: “If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,
controles.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
controles.livre: E se houver feito voto em casa de seu marido, e houver ligado sua alma com obrigação de juramento,

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמַ֤ע אִישָׁהּ֙ וְהֶחֱרִ֣שׁ לָ֔הּ לֹ֥א הֵנִ֖יא אֹתָ֑הּ וְקָ֨מוּ֙ כָּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ וְכָל־אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ יָקֽוּם׃

controles.web: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn’t disallow her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.
controles.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
controles.livre: Se seu marido ouviu, e calou a isso, e não lhe vedou; então todos os seus votos serão firmes, e toda obrigação com que houver ligado sua alma, firme será.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־הָפֵר֩ יָפֵ֨ר אֹתָ֥ם׀ אִישָׁהּ֮ בְּי֣וֹם שָׁמְעוֹ֒ כָּל־מוֹצָ֨א שְׂפָתֶ֧יהָ לִנְדָרֶ֛יהָ וּלְאִסַּ֥ר נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם אִישָׁ֣הּ הֲפֵרָ֔ם וַיהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח־לָֽהּ׃

controles.web: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
controles.kjv: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.
controles.livre: Mas se seu marido os anulou no dia que os ouviu; tudo o que saiu de seus lábios quanto a seus votos, e quanto à obrigação de sua alma, será nulo; seu marido os anulou, e o SENHOR a perdoará.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־נֵ֛דֶר וְכָל־שְׁבֻעַ֥ת אִסָּ֖ר לְעַנֹּ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ אִישָׁ֥הּ יְקִימֶ֖נּוּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ יְפֵרֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
controles.kjv: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
controles.livre: Todo voto, ou todo juramento obrigando-se a afligir a alma, seu marido o confirmará, ou seu marido o anulará.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־הַחֲרֵשׁ֩ יַחֲרִ֨ישׁ לָ֥הּ אִישָׁהּ֮ מִיּ֣וֹם אֶל־יוֹם֒ וְהֵקִים֙ אֶת־כָּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ א֥וֹ אֶת־כָּל־אֱסָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֑יהָ הֵקִ֣ים אֹתָ֔ם כִּי־הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ לָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם שָׁמְעֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her. He has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
controles.kjv: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
controles.livre: Porém se seu marido calar a isso de dia em dia, então confirmou todos os seus votos, e todas as obrigações que estão sobre ela: confirmou-as, porquanto calou a isso o dia que o ouviu.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־הָפֵ֥ר יָפֵ֛ר אֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁמְע֑וֹ וְנָשָׂ֖א אֶת־עֲוֺנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”
controles.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
controles.livre: Mas se as anular depois de havê-las ouvido, então ele levará o pecado dela.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ בֵּֽין־אָ֣ב לְבִתּ֔וֹ בִּנְעֻרֶ֖יהָ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ׃פ

controles.web: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
controles.kjv: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.
controles.livre: Estas são as ordenanças que o SENHOR mandou a Moisés entre o homem e sua mulher, entre o pai e sua filha, durante sua juventude em casa de seu pai.
